title: Gionatan Nese — counter, masked words, cards burst then gather
note: On load: "GN .D" in the centre, and a Teodor counter 001→100 at the bottom centre that rolls up out of an overflow-hidden box (translateY 16px → 0). The side words ("Gionatan" "Nese", "Multi-Disciplinary" "Designer") each slide up from translateY(100%) inside their own overflow-hidden span. The cards burst out of the centre as tiny thumbnails, gather into a single card, then spread into the sphere. Last, the logo flies from the centre to its slot in the nav: an invisible "GN .D" placeholder holds the space and the real logo is a fixed element moved with translate3d (a FLIP). The same loader runs between pages (it shows "097" before /projects). Worth reusing: the logo-into-nav FLIP and the per-word masks.
